title: Sync stalls silently when the device switches from WiFi to cellular
description: Sync stops without an error message when the network type changes. Restarting the app resumes sync.

title: Search ignores accented characters
description: Searching for cafe finds notes with café, but searching for café does not find notes with cafe or café.

title: Dark mode: code block text is unreadable (low contrast)
description: Code block text and background are both dark grey in dark theme.

title: PDF export cuts off the final pages of long notes
description: Notes longer than about 20 pages lose the last pages in the exported PDF.

title: Reminder notifications are delivered twice on Android
description: Each reminder produces two notifications a few seconds apart.

title: Attachments over 10 MB fail with a generic error
description: Uploading a file over 10 MB shows 'Something went wrong' with no hint about the size limit.

title: Tag autocomplete suggests deleted tags
description: After a tag is deleted it still appears in the # autocomplete list.

title: App crashes on launch after the iOS 19.1 update
description: Users on iOS 19.1 report an immediate crash on startup. A fix is in testing.

title: Shared-note link shows Access denied to invitees without an account
description: People invited by email who have not created an account see Access denied when they open the link.

title: Offline edits are overwritten by an older server version after reconnect
description: Edits made offline are replaced by the older server copy when the device reconnects.
